title: fix(objectql): a server boot's schema sync takes the schema-migration lock, so replicas starting together create each table once
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9XahPEEET2Vy9ZB5xcVcgHE)_

Fixes #31715

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：服务器启动时的表结构同步（含 `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`）现在和 `os migrate apply` 拿同一把数据库迁移锁，只在建表期间持有，同步完立即释放。
- 为什么改：多个副本同时启动会重复建同一张表，Postgres 报 `pg_type` 冲突，那个启动记下 `Schema sync FAILED` 却仍以 0 退出；实测可复现。
- 风险与回滚：单机无争用时只多一条加锁语句、输出逐字节不变；SQLite 不加锁。回滚即还原本 PR，锁模块挪回 cli。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`acquireBootSchemaMigrationLock` 与 Phase 1–3 的 try/finally）、`packages/objectql/src/schema-migration-lock.ts`（从 cli 挪来）、`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts`（新只读 getter `schemaDdlDeferred`）。
- 两分钟验证：`OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL=postgres://… pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration src/utils/schema-migration-lock.integration.test.ts`，预期 8/8 通过，三个启动各打印一行等待、每张表只建一次。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## #31598 card item 2 (quoted)

> 2. The lock is harmless on a single node (uncontended); keep its output identical apart from no new lines when uncontended. Note: this changes the single-node code path by one uncontended lock call; say so in the PR.

As there: this PR changes the single-node server boot by one uncontended lock call (`pg_try_advisory_lock` / `GET_LOCK` on a connection of its own, then the unlock), on Postgres and MySQL only. Nothing is printed when it is uncontended; the single-boot output was diffed byte for byte below.

## What changes

- **Where the boot syncs, measured.** A server boot's DDL is `ObjectQLPlugin.start()` Phase 1 (`installRegisteredSchemas`), Phase 2 (hydrate from `sys_metadata`) and Phase 3 (sync what Phase 2 added). `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1` is that same boot followed by an exit in `serve.ts`, so the lock goes into the engine's boot, not into `serve.ts`. **`serve.ts` is untouched.**
- **The lock.** `start()` takes it right before Phase 1 and releases it in `finally` after Phase 3 (a boot that fails between the phases releases it too). It is never held while the server runs. It is taken even when nothing turns out to be pending, so the "read what is missing, then create it" race is closed. It is taken on the default datasource's driver, the database the tables live in (as #31714 locks the primary).
- **No lock where this boot runs no DDL:** `skipSchemaSync` / `OS_SKIP_SCHEMA_SYNC=1`, and a default driver whose DDL `os migrate plan` / `apply` holds back. That command takes the lock itself before it reads what is pending; taking it in the boot too would make one migrator wait twice and spend a second uncontended statement. The engine reads this from a new read-only getter, `SqlDriver#schemaDdlDeferred`.
- **One lock, one module (seat ruling 1).** `schema-migration-lock.ts` and its unit test moved from `packages/cli/src/utils/` to `packages/objectql/src/`: `@objectstack/objectql` cannot import `@objectstack/cli` (the CLI depends on it), and objectql is the lowest package that holds a caller of the lock (`@objectstack/core` / `types` are driver-agnostic and call nothing here). It is exported from the objectql barrel (not the lean `./core` entry). `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-lock.ts` is now a re-export, so `bootSchemaStack` and the CLI tests import exactly what they did. Same name `objectstack:schema-migrate`, same Postgres key (its unit pin moved with it, unchanged).
- **Dialect from the driver, before its Knex (CI fix, `ab5e5910`).** The lock reads `SqlDriver#dialectName` (the driver's one public "which SQL do I speak") and calls `getKnex()` only for `postgres` / `mysql`. At `86ea712b` it asked every driver for its Knex first, and the Turso REMOTE transport refuses `getKnex()` by throwing, so a remote Turso boot failed in `ObjectQLPlugin.start()` (CI `Test Core (3/8)`, `organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts`). A Postgres or MySQL driver whose Knex cannot be handed out still throws; nothing is swallowed. `bootSchemaStack` passes the same `SqlDriver`, so the CLI path reads the same answer.
- **Wait bound.** A server boot waits at most half of `ObjectQLPlugin.startupTimeout` (60 s by default), so a boot queued behind a long migration refuses with the lock's own message (it names the lock and says nothing was changed) instead of the kernel's generic start timeout, and keeps the other half for its own sync. `os migrate apply` keeps its 10-minute bound.
- **Forced edit outside the named surface:** `packages/drivers/driver-turso/src/turso-driver.ts` gains one row in `REMOTE_FACE_ANSWERS` (`schemaDdlDeferred: 'inherited'`). That ledger is typed `Record<keyof SqlDriver, …>`, so the new getter fails the Turso DTS build until it is classified. It is `inherited` because the remote face refuses arming, so it always reads `false`.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/plugin-boot-schema-migration-lock.test.ts` (new, 6 pins): a real `ObjectKernel` boot with a stub default driver whose knex and `syncSchema` write into one ordered log. The lock comes before the first DDL and the unlock after the last; uncontended it is one lock statement and no line logged; contended it is one wait line, then DDL; a boot failing between the phases still unlocks; no lock for `skipSchemaSync` or a deferring driver; control: SQLite and memory drivers run no statement and sync as before.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/schema-migration-lock.integration.test.ts`: a second top-level describe in #31714's live-Postgres harness (ruling record 6583487846: one harness file per component). It holds the lock, starts three `os serve` boots with `OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`, waits until Postgres shows all three queued, then lets go. Asserted: all three queued; each exits 0 and prints exactly one wait line; none logs `Schema sync FAILED`; an event trigger sees each table created once; control: one more boot prints no wait line, creates nothing, exits 0. A named skip without `OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL`, as the apply cell; the event trigger needs a superuser URL.
- Moved: `schema-migration-lock.test.ts` (header text updated for its second caller). Its fake drivers now carry `dialectName`; the dialect pins assert `getKnex()` is never called for `sqlite` / `mssql` / `oracle` / `unknown` / none; new pins: a SQLite face whose `getKnex()` throws answers `null` without calling it, and a `postgres` / `mysql` driver whose `getKnex()` throws rejects with that error.
- `plugin-boot-schema-migration-lock.test.ts` gains a 7th pin: a SQLite-dialect default driver whose `getKnex()` throws (Turso remote) boots, is never asked for Knex, takes no lock and syncs.

## Acceptance notes

- Postgres and MySQL only, as #31714. MySQL is NOT MEASURED live (no MySQL server in the container); the MySQL statements are the module's own, pinned in its unit test.
- **The lock covers the default datasource only; DDL on any other datasource is unchanged by this PR.** Only the default datasource's database is locked (as #31714 locks the primary); objects bound to another SQL datasource on another database sync exactly as before, outside the lock.
- The `kernel:ready` platform-table repairs (`metadata-protocol` identity-index migrations, `IF [NOT] EXISTS` index DDL) run after the lock is released. In the 5 barrier-aligned runs and 2 staged integration runs with the fix, no boot logged a failure from them. The runtime resyncs (`metadata:reloaded`, `ObjectQL.syncSchemas` on install) are not boot DDL and are not touched.
- The red on main needs the boots aligned. Started together without help, tsx start jitter puts one boot about 100 ms ahead and it leads the whole sync: 4 unaided runs on main showed no collision. Held together at their first database round trip by a TCP barrier in front of Postgres (a measurement tool, not committed), main collided every valid time.

## Verification

Concurrency measurements at `3fa9769b` (main `4013e308` merged in), Postgres 16 in the container. `86ea712b` moved a JSDoc (no code change). Head `ab5e5910` fixes the Turso remote boot:

```text
runtime organization-ownership-boot-guard.turso-remote.kernel.test.ts  before (objectql dist of 86ea712b): 2 failed, "Handing out the Knex instance (`getKnex()`) is not supported by the Turso REMOTE transport"  /  after (rebuilt): 2 passed
runtime turso files 2/2 (9 tests) · rest remote-tables-twin 10/10 · cli schema-migrate.remote-posture 11/11
objectql   typecheck ✓ · vitest 577 files / 11736 tests passed (lock pins 26/26)
driver-turso typecheck ✓ · vitest 97 files, 2522 passed | 34 skipped
cli        typecheck ✓ · live-PG schema-migration-lock.integration.test.ts 8/8 (OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL set)
eslint --no-inline-config on the 4 changed .ts files: exit 0
```

<details><summary>Red on main (b126c130), green with the fix: concurrent boots on one fresh database</summary>

DDL counted from the Postgres log (`log_statement = ddl`); boots aligned by the barrier.

```text
main  3 x OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT  run A  CREATE TABLE 85 / distinct 84 / created twice: 1 (sys_migration) / pg_type_typname_nsp_index duplicate key x1 / all exit 0, one boot logged "Schema sync FAILED for object 'sys_migration'"
main  3 x OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT  run B  CREATE TABLE 85 / distinct 84 / created twice: 1 / pg_type collision x1 / all exit 0
main  2 x ordinary boot        run A  created twice: 1 / pg_type collision x1
main  2 x ordinary boot        run B  created twice: 1 / pg_type collision x1
      (a third main run was void: the barrier's own port was taken; both boots failed to connect)
fix   3 x OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT  2 runs  CREATE TABLE 84 / distinct 84 / created twice: 0 / no pg_type error / all exit 0 / 2 wait lines per run (one per waiter)
fix   2 x ordinary boot        3 runs  CREATE TABLE 84 / created twice: 0 / no pg_type error / both listening / 1 wait line per run
```
</details>

<details><summary>Control: single-boot output unchanged</summary>

Timestamps, durations, ports, temp paths and database names normalized; nothing else.

```text
single OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT boot, main vs fix: stdout IDENTICAL (0 lines), stderr IDENTICAL (11 lines)
single ordinary boot, main vs fix:            stdout IDENTICAL (0 lines), stderr IDENTICAL (32 lines)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: the lock call removed from ObjectQLPlugin.start()</summary>

`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const migrationLock = await this.acquireBootSchemaMigrationLock(ctx);` with `await Promise.resolve(null)` (anchor 1 → 0, planted 1). Rebuilt objectql: the build exits 1 because the DTS step rejects the now-unused private method, but the JS was written: `ablation-dist-preflight.mjs … --absent` shows the call absent from all 8 built files.

```text
unit   × locks before the first DDL… × uncontended: ONE lock statement… × contended: says ONCE… × a boot that fails… (4 failed | 2 passed)
live   × all three boots queued behind the held lock (expected +0 to be 3) × each boot … says ONCE that it waited (2 failed | 6 passed)
restore: blob == HEAD, git diff HEAD empty; rebuilt; preflight finds the call in dist/index.js and dist/index.mjs; live file 8/8 passed
```
</details>

<details><summary>Packages, lint, gates</summary>

```text
objectql   typecheck ✓ · vitest 577 files / 11732 tests passed (pre-merge head e02afaa6); after the main merge: typecheck ✓, the two lock files 22/22
driver-sql typecheck ✓ · vitest 246 passed | 13 skipped files, 4170 passed | 223 skipped tests
driver-turso typecheck ✓ · vitest 97 files, 2522 passed | 34 skipped
cli        typecheck ✓ (both heads) · unit tier 406 files / 5755 tests · live-PG file 8/8 (both heads; OS_TEST_POSTGRES_URL set)
eslint --no-inline-config on all 9 changed .ts files: exit 0
dispatch-gates --commands (79 derived on 3fa9769b): 79 run, 79 exit 0; --ran reconciliation: 79 derived, 79 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN
  (first round: teardown self-test, dual-build-cjs-loads and i18n-coverage exited 3 on prerequisites; green after fetching the teardown fixture and a full `pnpm build`)
```
</details>
